# Thesis: weak-signal ensemble on solvency and cash-flow CHANGES. Each leg alone is weak (daily IR .02-.05) but has low pool correlation (.1-.3), positive out-of-sample IR and tiny turnover; summing several nearly independent legs raises IR roughly with the square root of their number while keeping turnover and pool correlation low (the logic that qualified SWC_BS5_acc and T_COMP7). Long firms whose interest coverage, cash ratio, cash holdings, dividends and net cash flow are improving.
# Source: Campbell, Hilscher & Szilagyi, "In Search of Distress Risk" (JF 2008), https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1540-6261.2008.01416.x; Green, Hand & Zhang (RFS 2017), https://doi.org/10.1093/rfs/hhx019
# Note: legs and signs come from our field sweep (batches 2-3) and N_COVCHG; each sign held out of sample (OOS1 > 0).
# Repair: WSE_SOLV7 IR .057, TVR .060, corr .430 (OOS1 .048): two more nearly independent legs to lift IR past .07.
ta = ts_fill(total_assets)  # total assets, carried forward
cov = ts_fill(at_signlog(times_interest_earned_ratio))  # interest coverage, sign-log compressed
cr = ts_fill(at_signlog(cash_ratio))  # cash / current liabilities, sign-log compressed
k1 = cs_zscore(cov - ts_delay(cov, 120))  # 6-month change in interest coverage
k2 = cs_zscore(cr - ts_delay(cr, 120))  # 6-month change in cash ratio
c = ts_fill(balance_sheet_cash_near_cash_items)/ta  # cash holdings per dollar of assets
k3 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(c - ts_delay(c, 120)))  # 6-month change in cash holdings
d = ts_fill(dividends_paid)/ta  # dividends paid per dollar of assets
k4 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(d - ts_delay(d, 120)))  # 6-month change in payout
nc = ts_fill(net_change_in_cash)/ta  # net cash flow per dollar of assets
k5 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(nc - ts_delay(nc, 120)))  # 6-month change in net cash flow
oca = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(other_current_assets)/ta))  # other current assets per dollar of assets (sweep L, OOS1 .054)
cpd = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(current_portion_of_long_term_debt)/ta))  # debt due within a year per dollar of assets (sweep L, OOS1 .033)
cl = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(current_liabilities)/ta))  # short-term operating liabilities per dollar of assets (sweep L, IR .052, OOS1 .086)
gw = -cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(goodwill)/ta))  # goodwill-heavy (acquisitive) firms underperform (sweep L, IR -.035, OOS1 -.073)
alpha = at_zero2nan(at_nan2zero(k1) + at_nan2zero(k2) + at_nan2zero(k3) + at_nan2zero(k4) + at_nan2zero(k5) + at_nan2zero(oca) + at_nan2zero(cpd) + at_nan2zero(cl) + at_nan2zero(gw))  # 9-leg equal-weight ensemble

# Thesis: a short-horizon price/volume pattern (A54) blended with slow characteristics (BS) whose returns move against short-term reversal, so the blend keeps the pattern's IR with lower turnover and lower overlap with crowded pool alphas (the partner recipe behind our submissions).
# Source: Kakushadze, 101 Formulaic Alphas (2016), https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.00991 (Alpha #54); balance-sheet composition (Green, Hand & Zhang, RFS 2017, https://doi.org/10.1093/rfs/hhx019); our sweep batch 1
# Grid: base A54, partners BS, partner weight 1.0, neutralisation none.
loc = (low - close)/(low - high - 0.001*close)  # how far the close sits above the low, 0..1
b = cs_zscore(-loc*(open/close)**5)  # long closes near the low after a drop
ta = ts_fill(total_assets)  # total assets
p_bs = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(current_liabilities)/ta) + cs_rank(ts_fill(accounts_receivable_excluding_notes)/ta) - cs_rank(ts_fill(goodwill)/ta) + cs_rank(ts_fill(accumulated_depreciation)/ta))  # balance-sheet composite (our SWC_BS legs)
alpha = at_zero2nan(at_nan2zero(b) + 1.0*(at_nan2zero(p_bs)))  # base + 1.0x partners

# Thesis: a short-horizon price/volume pattern (A50) blended with slow characteristics (CL) whose returns move against short-term reversal, so the blend keeps the pattern's IR with lower turnover and lower overlap with crowded pool alphas (the partner recipe behind our submissions).
# Source: Kakushadze, 101 Formulaic Alphas (2016), https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.00991 (Alpha #50); current liabilities / assets (our strongest sweep leg, OOS1 .086)
# Grid: base A50, partners CL, partner weight 1.5, neutralisation size.
c = ts_corr_binary(cs_rank(volume), cs_rank(vwap_last_hour), 5)  # 5-day corr of volume rank and VWAP rank
b = cs_zscore(-ts_max(cs_rank(c), 5))  # short the most persistent co-movers
p_cl = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(current_liabilities)/ts_fill(total_assets)))  # short-term operating liabilities per dollar of assets
sz = cs_rank(at_signlog(mktcap))  # size rank (log market cap)
alpha = cs_factorneut(at_zero2nan(at_nan2zero(b) + 1.5*(at_nan2zero(p_cl))), [sz])  # base + 1.5x partners, size neutral

oc = (close - open)/open  # open-to-close return
b = cs_zscore(-ts_corr_binary(cs_rank(dv), cs_rank(oc), 5))  # short names whose volume and return ranks co-move
